questions.questionText: Five executives (A, B, C, D, E) sit in a row facing North. C sits at the center. A sits at the extreme left end. B sits between A and C. E sits to the immediate right of C. Who is sitting at the extreme right end?
questions.explanation: Positions 1 to 5 from left to right: A is at position 1 (extreme left). C is at position 3 (center). B is between A and C -> position 2. E is immediately right of C -> position 4. The only remaining position is 5 (extreme right), which must be occupied by D.

questions.questionText: Six friends (P, Q, R, S, T, U) are seated around a circular table facing the center. P is opposite S. Q is to the immediate right of P. R is to the immediate left of S. T is between P and U. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Q?
questions.explanation: Positions 1 to 6 clockwise: Let P = 1. Opposite S = 4. Q is immediately right (counter-clockwise or clockwise convention) of P. Let clockwise: P(1), Q(2). Opposite S(4). R is immediately left of S -> pos 5. T is between P and U -> U=3, T=2? If Q is at 6 (immediate left/right), with P at 1, T between P and U means P(1), T(6), U(5)? Let's place clockwise: 1:P, 2:Q, 3:U, 4:S, 5:R, 6:T. Then P opposite S (1 opposite 4). Q is to right of P (pos 2). R is left of S (pos 5). T is between P and R (pos 6). Then U sits at pos 3, between Q and S. Who is to the immediate right of Q? U.

questions.questionText: Seven students (J, K, L, M, N, O, P) are standing in a single line facing North. M is to the immediate right of L. K is at the extreme left end. P is between M and O. J is to the immediate left of L. If N is at the extreme right end, who is sitting in the exact middle position?
questions.explanation: Left to right (1 to 7): K is at 1 (extreme left), N is at 7 (extreme right). J is immediately left of L, M is immediately right of L -> J, L, M. P is between M and O -> J, L, M, P, O. Adding K at 1 and N at 7 gives: 1:K, 2:J, 3:L, 4:M, 5:P, 6:O, 7:N. The exact middle position is 4, occupied by M.

questions.questionText: Eight people sit around a circular table facing the center. A is third to the left of B. C is second to the right of A. D is opposite A. How many people sit between B and C when counted clockwise from B?
questions.explanation: Let B be at position 1. Facing center, left is clockwise: 1:B, 2, 3, 4:A (A is 3rd to left of B). C is second to right of A (counter-clockwise): from pos 4, two steps CCW returns to pos 2! B is at pos 1, C is at pos 2. When counted clockwise from B to C, there is 0 person between them (they are immediate neighbors).

questions.questionText: Eight colleagues sit in two parallel rows of four each facing each other. Row 1 faces South: P, Q, R, S. Row 2 faces North: A, B, C, D. Q is opposite B. P is at the extreme right of Row 1 (facing South, so western end). A is opposite P. D is at the extreme right of Row 2. Who sits opposite D?
questions.explanation: Row 1 (faces South, left is East, right is West): P is at extreme right (pos 1). A is opposite P in Row 2 (pos 1). D is at extreme right of Row 2 (pos 4, East end). The person opposite D is the person at pos 4 of Row 1. If Q is opposite B (pos 2 or 3), S and R occupy the other positions. If S is at pos 4, S sits opposite D.

questions.questionText: Four people (W, X, Y, Z) sit at the four sides of a square table facing the center. W sits opposite Y. X sits to the right of W. Who sits to the left of W?
questions.explanation: The four sides are opposite pairs (W-Y) and (X-Z). W faces center; to W's right is X. The remaining side to W's left must be occupied by Z.

questions.questionText: Six family members sit in a row facing North. Grandfather is not at either extreme end. Father sits immediately between Son and Mother. Grandfather is to the immediate left of Son. Who is to the immediate right of Grandfather?
questions.explanation: The statement explicitly says: "Grandfather is to the immediate left of Son." Therefore, to the immediate right of Grandfather is the Son.

questions.questionText: Five students (V, W, X, Y, Z) sit in a row facing South. Facing South, left is towards East and right is towards West. X sits second to the left of V. Y sits at the extreme right end. Who sits between Y and V if W sits at the extreme left end?
questions.explanation: Facing South: extreme right is pos 1 (West), extreme left is pos 5 (East). Y is at pos 1. W is at pos 5. X is second to the left of V (two positions to the East of V). If V is at pos 2, X is at pos 4 (2+2=4). Then Z is at pos 3. The person between Y(1) and V(2) is no one? Wait, if Y is at pos 1, V is at pos 2, they are adjacent! What if V is at pos 3? Then between Y(1) and V(3) is Z(2)! Positions: 1:Y, 2:Z, 3:V, 4:?, 5:W. If V is at 3, second to left of V is pos 5 (W), so X would be at 5, but W is at 5. If V is at 2, second to left is pos 4 (X). Then Z occupies pos 3. Thus Z is between V and X, and between Y and V there is no one.

questions.questionText: Seven friends (A, B, C, D, E, F, G) sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits third to the right of B. C sits second to the left of A. D sits between B and C. E sits to the immediate left of A. F sits between E and G. Who is sitting to the immediate right of B?
questions.explanation: Let B be at position 1. Clockwise: A is 3rd to right -> pos 4. C is 2nd to left of A -> pos 2. D is between B and C -> pos 1.5? Wait, if B=1, C=3, then D is at pos 2 (between B and C). A is at pos 5. E is immediate left of A -> pos 4. F is between E and G -> pos 6, 7. Positions in circular order: 1:B, 2:D, 3:C, 4:E, 5:A, 6:F, 7:G. To the immediate right (CCW or CW) of B is G (pos 7) on one side and D (pos 2) on the other. Facing center, right of B is G. Thus G sits to the immediate right of B.

questions.questionText: In a row of 25 students facing North, Priya is 12th from the left end and Divya is 8th from the right end. How many students sit between Priya and Divya?
questions.explanation: Total students = 25. Position of Priya from left = 12. Position of Divya from left = 25 - 8 + 1 = 18. Students between them = (18 - 12) - 1 = 5 students.

questions.questionText: Six persons (A, B, C, D, E, F) sit around a circular table. Three face inside (towards center) and three face outside. A faces inside and B sits second to the right of A. C faces outside and sits to the immediate left of B. Who sits opposite A?
questions.explanation: In a 6-person circular table, the opposite position to pos 1 is pos 4. The person at pos 4 is opposite A.

questions.questionText: Five cars are parked in a straight row. Audi is parked next to BMW. Mercedes is parked next to Toyota. BMW is not next to Mercedes. Audi is parked between Tesla and BMW. If Tesla is at the extreme left end, which car is in the center?
questions.explanation: Tesla is at pos 1. Audi is between Tesla and BMW -> pos 2 is Audi, pos 3 is BMW. Mercedes is next to Toyota, and not next to BMW. So pos 4 is Toyota, pos 5 is Mercedes. The center car (pos 3) is BMW.

questions.questionText: Eight delegates sit around a rectangular table, with 3 on each longer side and 1 on each shorter side. Delegate X sits at a shorter side. How many delegates sit between X and delegate Y who sits at the opposite shorter side?
questions.explanation: The rectangular perimeter has 1 + 3 + 1 + 3 = 8 seats. Between the two opposite shorter ends, there are exactly 3 delegates along each longer side.

questions.questionText: Seven runners stand on a victory podium numbered 1 to 7. Runner P is on rank 4. Runner Q is immediately above P (rank 3). Runner R is on rank 7. If S is immediately below P, what is S's rank?
questions.explanation: Runner P is at rank 4. Immediately below rank 4 is rank 5. Therefore, Runner S is at rank 5.

questions.questionText: In a row of 30 children facing North, Rohan is 18th from the right end. If there are 4 children between Rohan and Mohan, and Mohan is to the left of Rohan, what is Mohan's rank from the left end?
questions.explanation: Rohan from right = 18th => Rohan from left = 30 - 18 + 1 = 13th. Mohan is to the left of Rohan with 4 children between them => Mohan is at 13 - 4 - 1 = 8th position from the left end.

questions.questionText: Six people (K, L, M, N, O, P) sit in a circular arrangement facing the center. K is opposite N. L is between K and M. P is between N and O. If M is opposite P, who is opposite L?
questions.explanation: Circular pairs opposite each other in a 6-person ring: K is opposite N. M is opposite P. The remaining pair must be opposite each other: L is opposite O.

questions.questionText: Ten students sit in two parallel rows of 5 each facing each other. Row 1: A, B, C, D, E. Row 2: V, W, X, Y, Z. If C is in the middle of Row 1 (position 3), who sits directly opposite C in Row 2?
questions.optionA: The person at the extreme left of Row 2
questions.optionB: The person at the extreme right of Row 2
questions.optionD: The person in the middle position (position 3) of Row 2
questions.explanation: In parallel rows of 5 each, the middle position of Row 1 (pos 3) faces directly opposite the middle position of Row 2 (pos 3).

questions.questionText: In a class test rank list, Aman is 7th from the top and 28th from the bottom. How many total students are in the class?
questions.explanation: Total students = (Rank from top) + (Rank from bottom) - 1 = 7 + 28 - 1 = 34 students.

questions.questionText: Four friends (P, Q, R, S) play carrom sitting on four sides. P is the partner of R (sitting opposite). Q is the partner of S. If Q sits facing North, which direction does S face?
questions.explanation: Partners in carrom sit opposite each other facing each other. If Q faces North, Q's partner S sits opposite Q and faces South.

questions.questionText: Seven boys (A, B, C, D, E, F, G) stand in a line. D is to the immediate left of C. B is to the immediate right of E. A is to the right of C. E and C have two boys between them. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Relative block: E _ _ C. B is immediately right of E -> E, B, _ , C. D is immediately left of C -> E, B, D, C. Adding remaining boys gives: F, G, E, B, D, C, A. The middle boy (position 4) is B.

questions.questionText: Six teachers (T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6) sit in a row facing North. T3 sits between T1 and T5. T2 sits at the extreme right end. T4 is to the immediate left of T2. If T1 is at the extreme left end, what is the position of T6?
questions.explanation: Positions 1 to 6: Pos 1 is T1 (extreme left). T3 is between T1 and T5 => Pos 2 is T3, Pos 3 is T5. Pos 6 is T2 (extreme right). Pos 5 is T4 (immediate left of T2). Pos 4 must be occupied by T6. Thus T6 sits between T5 and T4.

questions.questionText: Eight people sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits second to the right of B. B sits opposite C. D sits to the immediate left of C. What is the position of D relative to A?
questions.optionC: Third to the right of A
questions.optionD: Second to the left of A
questions.explanation: Let C be at pos 1. B is opposite C -> pos 5. D is immediate left of C -> pos 8. A is second to right of B (pos 5 -> pos 3). From pos 3 (A), counting clockwise to pos 8 (D): 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 is 5 steps clockwise (or 3 steps counter-clockwise, meaning 3rd to right). Thus D is third to the right of A.

questions.questionText: In a row of 40 children facing North, Suresh is 11th from the left and Vinod is 31st from the right. How many children are between them?
questions.explanation: Left rank of Vinod = 40 - 31 + 1 = 10th. Left rank of Suresh = 11th. Vinod is 10th and Suresh is 11th. They are immediate neighbors! There are 0 children between them.

questions.questionText: Five books (Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English) are stacked vertically. Math is immediately above Physics. Biology is immediately below Chemistry. English is between Physics and Chemistry. Which book is in the exact middle?
questions.explanation: Stack from top to bottom: Math, Physics, English, Chemistry, Biology. The exact middle book (3rd book) is English.

questions.questionText: Seven people (P, Q, R, S, T, U, V) sit in a row facing North. R sits to the immediate right of Q. S is at the extreme left. T is between R and U. P sits to the immediate left of V, who is at the extreme right. Who sits in the center?
questions.explanation: Positions 1 to 7: 1:S. 7:V, 6:P. Q, R, T, U remain for positions 2, 3, 4, 5. Q is at 2, R is at 3. T is between R and U => 4:T, 5:U. Complete row: S(1), Q(2), R(3), T(4), U(5), P(6), V(7). The center position (4) is T.

questions.questionText: Four students sit at the four corners of a square table facing the center. A sits diagonally opposite C. B sits to the right of A. Who sits diagonally opposite B?
questions.explanation: In a 4-corner square table, the two diagonal pairs are (A-C) and (B-D). The person diagonally opposite B is D.

questions.questionText: In a queue of 20 people facing forward, Priya is 7th from the front and Swati is 10th from the back. How many people are between Priya and Swati?
questions.explanation: Priya is at position 7 from front. Swati is at position 20 - 10 + 1 = 11 from front. People between them = (11 - 7) - 1 = 3 people.

questions.questionText: Six friends sit in a circle facing the center. Ankit sits between Rohit and Mohit. Saurabh sits between Deepak and Mohit. Who sits opposite Rohit?
questions.explanation: Circle of 6: Ankit is between Rohit and Mohit -> R, A, M. Saurabh is between Deepak and Mohit -> M, S, D. Order: R(1), A(2), M(3), S(4), D(5), ... wait: 6th person? R, A, M, S, D... opposite R(1) in a 6-person circle is position 4, which is Saurabh! Therefore, Saurabh sits opposite Rohit.

questions.questionText: A group of 8 dancers stand in a circle facing inward. Dancer 1 is opposite Dancer 5. If Dancer 3 moves to stand between Dancer 6 and Dancer 7, how many dancers remain between Dancer 1 and Dancer 4 on the clockwise side?
questions.optionB: 2 dancers (Dancers 2 and 3? Now Dancer 3 moved, so only Dancer 2 remains!)
questions.explanation: Initially, clockwise from 1: 1, 2, 3, 4. Between 1 and 4 were 2 and 3. When Dancer 3 moves away, only Dancer 2 remains between 1 and 4. Thus exactly 1 dancer remains.

questions.questionText: In a row facing North, A is 15th from the left end and B is 4th from the right end. If there are 3 boys between A and B, and B is to the right of A, how many boys are in the row?
questions.explanation: Total boys = (Left rank of A) + (Boys between) + (Right rank of B) = 15 + 3 + 4 = 22 boys.

questions.questionText: Five diplomats (USA, UK, France, Germany, Japan) sit around a circular table. UK sits between USA and France. Japan sits to the right of France. Who sits to the left of USA?
questions.explanation: Order: USA, UK, France. Japan is to right of France -> USA, UK, France, Japan, Germany. To the left of USA is Germany.

questions.questionText: In a cinema row of 50 seats, Karan is sitting on seat 20 from the left. Arjun is sitting on seat 15 from the right. How many empty seats are between them if all other seats are empty?
questions.explanation: Arjun from right is 15 => Arjun from left is 50 - 15 + 1 = 36. Seats between Karan (20) and Arjun (36) = (36 - 20) - 1 = 15 seats.

questions.questionText: Seven family members sit in a row. The youngest child sits in the middle. The two grandparents sit at the extreme ends. If the father sits immediately to the left of the youngest child, who sits immediately to the right of the father?
questions.explanation: If the father is to the immediate left of the child, then the child is to the immediate right of the father.

questions.questionText: Six cars (C1 to C6) are in a single-file traffic jam. C2 is directly behind C1. C5 is directly ahead of C6. C3 is between C2 and C4. If C1 is at the front, what is the position of C3 from the front?
questions.explanation: Front to back: 1st is C1. C2 is directly behind C1 -> 2nd is C2. C3 is between C2 and C4 -> 3rd is C3, 4th is C4. C3 is 3rd from the front.

questions.questionText: In a class of 60 students where girls are twice that of boys (40 girls, 20 boys), Kamal (a boy) ranked 17th from the top. If 9 girls are ahead of Kamal, how many boys are ranked after him?
questions.explanation: Total boys = 20. Ahead of Kamal (rank 17) there are 16 students. 9 of these are girls, so 16 - 9 = 7 boys are ahead of Kamal. Including Kamal, that accounts for 7 + 1 = 8 boys. Boys ranked after Kamal = 20 - 8 = 12 boys.

questions.questionText: Eight colleagues sit around a square table, 2 on each side. A sits on the North side with B. C sits on the South side directly opposite A. Who sits directly opposite B?
questions.optionA: The person sitting with C on the South side
questions.optionB: A person on the East side
questions.optionC: A person on the West side
questions.explanation: Opposite sides of a square table are North and South. The two seats on the North side face directly across to the two seats on the South side. The person opposite B is the second person sitting on the South side.

questions.questionText: Four runners finish a relay: A, B, C, D. B finished immediately before D. A finished after C. If C was first, who was second?
questions.optionB: Either A or B (depending on whether A or B-D pair finished second)
questions.explanation: C is 1st. Remaining are A, B, D. B is immediately before D (BD block). Possibility 1: C, BD, A -> C, B, D, A (B is 2nd). Possibility 2: C, A, BD -> C, A, B, D (A is 2nd). Thus 2nd could be A or B.

questions.questionText: In a row of boys facing North, when Nitin shifts 3 places to his right, he becomes 8th from the right end. What was his original position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Shifting to the right brings a person closer to the right end (reduces the rank from the right). If his new rank is 8th from the right after shifting 3 places right, his original rank was 8 + 3 = 11th from the right end.

questions.questionText: Three couples (6 people) sit in a cinema row. Every husband sits to the immediate left of his wife. How many different arrangements of the three couples are possible along the row?
questions.explanation: Treat each husband-wife unit as 1 combined block (since the husband must sit immediately left of the wife, internal order is fixed: H W). The 3 couple blocks can be permuted among themselves in 3! = 6 ways.

questions.questionText: A circular table has 12 numbered seats 1 to 12 like a clock. If Person X sits at seat 1, and Person Y sits at seat 7, what is the geometric relationship between X and Y?
questions.optionA: They sit directly opposite each other across the center
questions.optionD: They sit adjacent to each other
questions.explanation: In a 12-seat circle, 1 and 7 are exactly 6 seats apart (180 degrees), meaning they sit directly opposite each other across the diameter.

questions.questionText: Five students (A, B, C, D, E) sit in a row facing North. D sits to the immediate left of E. B sits to the immediate right of C. A is at the extreme left end. If E is at the extreme right end, who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: 1:A (extreme left), 5:E (extreme right). D is immediate left of E -> 4:D. Remaining are B and C for 2 and 3. B is immediate right of C -> 2:C, 3:B. Order: A, C, B, D, E. Middle student is B.

questions.questionText: Six people sit in a circle facing the center. A is opposite B. C is between A and D. E is opposite D. Who is between B and E?
questions.explanation: Circle of 6: A opposite B (pos 1, 4). D opposite E (pos 2, 5 or 3, 6). C is between A and D -> pos 2. Then D is at pos 3. Opposite D(3) is E(6). Remaining position between B(4) and E(6) is pos 5, which must be occupied by F.

questions.questionText: In a row of 35 students facing North, Ramesh is 15th from the left and Suresh is 15th from the right. How many students sit between them?
questions.explanation: Sum of ranks = 15 + 15 = 30. Total = 35. Since 30 < 35, there is no overlap. Students between them = 35 - 30 = 5 students.

questions.questionText: Seven executives sit around a round conference table. Chairman sits at seat 1. Vice Chairman sits directly opposite Chairman (if even, but 7 is odd!). For odd number N=7, who sits directly opposite seat 1?
questions.optionC: No single seat is directly opposite seat 1 in an odd-numbered table
questions.explanation: In a regular polygon with an odd number of vertices (such as a heptagon with 7 seats), a vertex is opposite an edge, not another vertex. Thus no single seat is directly opposite seat 1.

questions.questionText: Eight books are arranged on a shelf. Book 1 is at the extreme left. Book 8 is at the extreme right. If Book 4 and Book 5 swap places, which book is now 5th from the left?
questions.explanation: Original 5th position was occupied by Book 5. When Book 4 and Book 5 swap places, Book 4 moves to the 5th position.

questions.questionText: In a parallel row setup, Row 1 (A, B, C) faces South, Row 2 (X, Y, Z) faces North. B is in the center of Row 1. Y is in the center of Row 2. When B looks straight ahead, who does B see?
questions.explanation: Center of Row 1 faces directly opposite the center of Row 2. B sees Y directly ahead.

questions.questionText: Five runners finish: First, Second, Third, Fourth, Fifth. Runner P finished ahead of Q. Runner R finished ahead of S. Runner T finished last. If P was not first, and R was not first, who was first?
questions.optionA: The premise is impossible if only {P, Q, R, S, T} compete and P>Q, R>S, T=last
questions.optionB: Neither P nor R, so Q or S? But P is ahead of Q, and R is ahead of S! So neither Q nor S can be first! Then who is first?
questions.explanation: If P > Q, Q cannot be first. If R > S, S cannot be first. T is last. If neither P nor R can be first, no candidate remains to finish first! This highlights a contradictory constraint set.

questions.questionText: In a circular dining table of 8 seats, Alice sits next to Bob, and Bob sits next to Charlie. Does Alice sit next to Charlie?
questions.optionB: Only if the table is rectangular
questions.optionC: No, Bob is between Alice and Charlie
questions.explanation: If Alice is on one side of Bob and Charlie is on the other side of Bob, Bob separates Alice and Charlie. In an 8-seat table, Alice and Charlie are separated by Bob and do not sit next to each other.

questions.questionText: Ten students sit in a single row. How many pairs of immediate neighbors are there in the row?
questions.explanation: In a linear row of n elements, the number of adjacent pairs is n - 1. For 10 students, there are 10 - 1 = 9 adjacent pairs.

questions.questionText: A person is 11th from both ends of a line. How many people are in the line?
questions.explanation: Total = 11 + 11 - 1 = 21 people.

questions.questionText: Four players play Ludo: North, South, East, West. Red sits opposite Yellow. Green sits to the right of Red. Who sits to the right of Green?
questions.explanation: Let Red be at North. Facing center, right is West -> Green is at West. Right of Green (facing center from West) is South, which is opposite Red (Yellow). Thus Yellow sits to the right of Green.

questions.questionText: In a row of 20 girls facing North, Renu is shifted 4 places to the left, and she becomes 6th from the left end. What was her earlier position from the right end?
questions.explanation: New position from left = 6th. Shifted 4 places left => Earlier position from left was 6 + 4 = 10th. Earlier position from right end = 20 - 10 + 1 = 11th.

questions.questionText: Six people sit in a row facing North: A, B, C, D, E, F. Exactly two people sit between A and B. Exactly two people sit between B and C. If A is at the extreme left end, what is C's position?
questions.optionA: The configuration requires at least 7 seats if A, B, C are distinct
questions.optionD: 7th (impossible in 6-person row) or C is at position 1? If A=1, B=4 (2 between A and B: pos 2, 3). Two between B(4) and C: pos 7 (out of bounds) or backward: pos 1 (already A).
questions.explanation: If A is at 1, two people between A and B puts B at 4. For two people to be between B(4) and C, C must be at 4 + 3 = 7 (exceeding 6 seats) or 4 - 3 = 1 (already occupied by A). Thus C cannot be placed in a 6-seat row.

questions.questionText: In a queue, A is 10th from the front and B is 15th from the back. If they swap positions, A becomes 22nd from the front. How many people are in the queue?
questions.explanation: After swap, A occupies B's original position. That position is 22nd from front and 15th from back. Total = 22 + 15 - 1 = 36 people.

questions.questionText: Five people (P, Q, R, S, T) sit in a row. R is not at any end. S is to the immediate right of P. Q is to the immediate left of T. If P is at the extreme left, who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: 1:P. S is immediate right of P -> 2:S. Q is immediate left of T -> Q and T must be adjacent. R is not at any end -> R cannot be 5. So R must be 3! Then 4:Q, 5:T. Complete order: P, S, R, Q, T. The middle person is R.

questions.questionText: Eight friends sit in a circle. Each person shakes hands with every person except the ones sitting immediately next to them. How many handshakes occur in total?
questions.explanation: Total pairs among 8 people = 8 * 7 / 2 = 28. Each person has 2 immediate neighbors, corresponding to the 8 perimeter edges of the octagon. Handshakes with non-neighbors = Diagonals of an octagon = 28 - 8 = 20 handshakes.

questions.questionText: In a row of 15 children facing North, Kamal is 8th from the left. What is Kamal's rank from the right?
questions.explanation: Rank from right = 15 - 8 + 1 = 8th. Kamal is at the exact midpoint (8th from both ends).

questions.questionText: Six people sit around a circular table facing outward (away from the center). P sits to the right of Q. Facing outward, does P sit in the clockwise or counter-clockwise direction relative to Q?
questions.explanation: When facing outward (away from the center of the circle), an observer at the top of the circle facing North has their right hand pointing East, which corresponds to the clockwise direction. Therefore, sitting to the right when facing outward corresponds to the clockwise position.

questions.questionText: Four candidates sit for an interview panel in a row. Candidate 1 cannot sit next to Candidate 2. In how many of the 24 total permutations do Candidate 1 and Candidate 2 NOT sit next to each other?
questions.explanation: Total permutations of 4 candidates = 4! = 24. Number of arrangements where Candidate 1 and 2 sit together: treat (1, 2) as a block: 3! * 2! = 6 * 2 = 12. Arrangements where they do NOT sit together = 24 - 12 = 12.

questions.questionText: Seven players sit in a circle. Player 1 passes a ball to the player sitting second to his left. If this 2-step skip passing continues indefinitely, will every player eventually receive the ball?
questions.optionA: No, only odd-numbered players will receive it
questions.optionB: No, only even-numbered players will receive it
questions.optionD: No, the ball will loop between only two players
questions.explanation: In a circle of N elements with step size S, every element is visited if and only if gcd(S, N) = 1. Here N=7 (prime) and S=2. Since gcd(2, 7) = 1, the passing forms a Hamiltonian cycle visiting all 7 players.
